notes.title: Yearly update
notes.content:
Another year, another update. Hive P v. S has received its annual checkup to make sure everything is running smoothly. In addition some improvements have been made.

Change log for 1.0.895 release
[list]
[*] Maintenance update with updated dependencies.
[*] Performance improvement.
[*] Updated manual and tutorial with level progression information.
[*] Escape pauses / shows the menu (in addition to M and P keys).
[*] Mouse movement when running fullscreen on a Mac has been fixed.
[*] Minor fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Maintenance update
notes.content:
Updated dependencies.
Switched build tools to same as new projects from SMJN AB.
Switched to a more modern steamworks library.
Replaced Mac builds with a single universal build.
Minor fixes and tweaks.
